claims.claim: 127 tok/s single-stream; ~1035 tok/s aggregate at 64; TP=2; controlled/community 2×RTX 3090 A/B reports +16–35% decode C1–C8 (DFlash2 C1 127.4→161.6 tok/s); ~9.5 GB image + ~20 GB prepared model
claims.decision: Relevant candidate for this dual-3090/128 GB host. Primary local A/B should be TP=2 vs ASTRA/SOL; TP=1 vs TP=2 is secondary efficiency analysis. Blocked by safe storage capacity; not downloaded. No P2P driver changes.

claims.claim: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next uses Strata engine; own CUDA engine targets other model families
claims.decision: No separate Flash-Next engine comparison enabled.

claims.claim: Maya-S24: 53 tok/s decode and 885 tok/s prefill on another 2x RTX 3090/128 GB host; model about 94.7 GB
claims.decision: Complementary model family; not a matched Qwen/ASTRA comparison and cannot fit current storage.

claims.claim: 190 tok/s Q4 single request and 622 tok/s aggregate at 8 requests; test host used NVIDIA open driver with P2P patch
claims.decision: No driver change; outside current host test scope.

claims.claim: Sandbox policies for filesystem, process, network and credentials
claims.decision: Potential containment layer; does not supply the trusted tenant principal/authz contract missing in Q78.

localFindings.q76: 94/94 Linux Release tests plus loopback regressions passed; implemented.
localFindings.q77: Inconclusive for deferred dispatch: 0/3 model runs emitted a deferred batch; no rerun warranted on same fixture.
localFindings.q78: Cross-tenant test requires a real authenticated principal and resource-authorization backend.

hardwareCorrection.secondary: HyperQwen TP=1 vs TP=2, same model/runtime, to quantify value of freeing one GPU
hardwareCorrection.concurrency: C64 only as separate matched workload; do not compare aggregate C64 throughput with single-request latency
